I’ll make this a single-file AI Video Generation Studio that runs directly on GitHub Pages—no React, no npm, no build tools, and no paid APIs.

It will focus on children’s animation and educational videos, with browser-based scene creation, animated previews, text-to-speech where supported, image uploads, and video export. The important distinction: it can produce videos from your own media and browser-generated animations, but it won’t generate original AI artwork or AI-written scripts without an actual model or service.

Option 1 — Just the HTML file

Best if you want the simplest possible GitHub Pages setup. One file, no dependencies.

Download index.html

Option 2 — ZIP package

Download the ZIP

How to publish it on GitHub Pages

  1. Download index.html using the link above.

  2. Create a GitHub repository, or open your existing repository.

  3. Upload index.html directly to the root of the repository and commit the change.

  4. Open Settings → Pages. Under Build and deployment, select Deploy from a branch, choose main and /(root), then save.

  5. Wait for GitHub Pages to publish the site, then open the URL it provides.

What works in this version?

  • Create, edit, reorder and delete scenes.

  • Turn paragraphs into separate scenes.

  • Animate characters, stickers, backgrounds and captions.

  • Upload your own illustrations.

  • Preview narration using voices available in your browser.

  • Export the animated video as WebM.

  • Save projects in your browser and export/import project JSON.

Current limitations: This is a working browser-based video creator, not a full generative AI engine. It doesn't generate original AI artwork or AI scripts, and the exported video doesn't include the browser's spoken narration. Video export depends on browser recording support. I verified the JavaScript syntax and ZIP integrity, but have not confirmed a live GitHub Pages deployment or tested video export across browsers.
